The Phantoms Hockey Hub is a small team website for keeping the season organized. It brings live SportNinja data, team reminders, and contact information together.

::: {.brand-lockup}
![](logos/phantoms-logo-transparent.png){fig-alt="Phantoms skater logo"}
:::

## Site Goals

::: {.feature-grid .compact}
::: {.feature-card}
### Centralize

Keeps schedule, standings, statistics, and recurring team notes in one place.
:::

::: {.feature-card}
### Clarify

Any questions, please see us at the game/practice or email us.
:::

::: {.feature-card}
### Preserve

Keep a simple season history as information changes over time.
:::
:::
